postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati won the line of the game. 484 yards on 7.4 per play against 222 and 3.8, plus 35:09 of possession. Burrow was clean, no turnovers either way, and 5-of-6 in the red zone.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 35/44, 409 yards, 4 TD, 0 INT. One sack taken for 3 yards.
Ja'Marr Chase: 11 catches, 231 yards. No scores needed, he just moved the whole field.
Chase Brown: 10 carries for 44 yards and 8 catches for 39 yards with 2 receiving TDs.
postgame.division_meaning: Bengals are 7-2 on a W5 streak with a +85 differential and sole possession of first. Pittsburgh falls to 6-3, Cleveland is 6-4 after beating Houston 27-24, Baltimore 4-5 on an L4 slide.
postgame.the_take: Rodgers threw for 143 yards and Pittsburgh went 0-for-2 in the red zone. That defensive performance is the real story here, not the 409 passing yards everyone will post about.

lines: Sunday night in Mexico City is the headliner: Vikings at 49ers, SF -3, total 46.5, 9:20 am Perth Monday. San Francisco is 8-1 after outscoring Dallas 46-40, Minnesota 7-2 off a 30-10 win at Lambeau.
Steelers go to Philadelphia at PIT -4.5 with a 38.5 total. Pittsburgh is 6-3 and coming off the loss in Cincinnati, the Eagles are 2-7.
Buffalo is 8-1 after 31-12 over the Jets and lays 16.5 at home to 1-8 Miami. Kansas City, 7-2 after Mahomes threw five scores in Atlanta, is also a 16.5-point favourite over Arizona.
Ravens at Panthers is the AFC North game that matters elsewhere: Baltimore is 4-6 and on a five-game slide after losing 23-20 to the 1-8 Chargers, and they are 2.5-point underdogs in Charlotte.
Jaguars at 7-2 head to MetLife as 6-point favourites over the Giants after a 40-23 win in Tennessee. Trevor Lawrence went 25/35 for 352 and 3 TD.
Thursday night is Colts at Texans, HOU -11.5, total 44.5, 9:15 am Perth Friday. Both teams are going nowhere at 3-7 and 3-6.
